protocol: First in-process invocation cold; remaining warm; OS caches uncontrolled. Full-buffer decode excluded; streaming decode included. Peak RSS is process high-water mark. CPU is process kernel+user time / wall time. Model instances load once before first inference; load time reported separately. First inference cold after load; later runs reuse the session. Each Basic Pitch invocation reuses one input tensor wrapper across its windows. Empty ONNX input is skipped. No automatic warmup; measured runs themselves warm the session.
